Delivering Compassionate,
Expert Care
at Our Veterinary Specialty Centers in Florida and South Carolina
Fetch Specialty & Emergency Veterinary Centers is a family-owned practice providing elevated specialty care, emergency medicine, and critical care in convenient locations throughout Florida and South Carolina. Our board-certified veterinarians and highly skilled support staff all share a deep appreciation for pets, people, and the human-animal bond.
We recognize how much you love your pet as a part of your family, and that’s why we love what we do!
Fetch works closely together with you and your primary care veterinarian to resolve any complex health problems your pet might have. Regardless of their ultimate diagnosis, our team will stop at nothing to find an effective treatment that is uniquely tailored to your pet.

Our Critical Care, Specialty and Emergency Services
Fetch offers an array of specialty veterinary services, along with emergency care. Our core services for your pet include:
Emergency
Emergency
We offer 24/7 emergency and critical care for pets, with advanced diagnostics, an ICU, and two surgery suites to help our patients get back on their feet.
Learn More
Internal Medicine
Internal Medicine
Internal medicine involves diagnosing, treating, and managing a wide variety of diseases and disorders, including heart disease, kidney disease, diabetes, endocrine disorders, and more.
Learn More
Surgery
Surgery
Our board-certified surgeon is qualified to perform an extensive range of complex emergency surgeries,
TPLO
, oncologic surgeries, orthopedics, neurologic surgeries, and soft-tissue surgeries.
Learn More
Medical Oncology
Medical Oncology
Fetch is equipped to provide exceptional pet oncology services to diagnose, monitor, and treat a wide range of cancers in dogs and cats.
Learn More
Ophthalmology
Ophthalmology
We’re excited to offer veterinary ophthalmology! Dr. Brittany Schlesener is exceedingly kind and compassionate and will help you with any eye-related issues your pet might be having.
Learn More
Radiation Oncology
Radiation Oncology
At Fetch, we utilize radiation oncology to make an impact on your pet’s cancer treatment. Radiation can extend and improve their life, and it can provide pain relieving benefits, too.
Learn More
Critical Care
Critical Care
We are equipped and trained to provide lifesaving critical care, and will stop at nothing to help your pet make a full recovery.
